name: propose_scene
description: Stage a scene/group proposal for the customer to review before committing anything -- does NOT create it yet. Shows up in review_plan's staged_ops list; edit it with revise_plan, remove it with revise_plan(remove=true), or commit every staged item (this and any others) at once with apply_plan. params must match multi_device_scene's own input_schema exactly -- it's passed through verbatim at apply time.

params.description: Same shape as multi_device_scene's arguments (group_name, devices with roles, etc.) -- see that tool's own description for the full grammar.
